rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Speaking first at the ceremony, D. Medvedev says that on "completing my work in the post of head of state" he thanks those who supported him, and that "today Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin will become President".
rows.locator: Transcript after '* * *': Medvedev's address, final paragraphs

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 82(1) of the Constitution, Zorkin asks Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin to take the oath, and Putin recites the presidential oath; the lead says the President-elect took the oath of loyalty to the people of Russia.
rows.locator: Lead paragraph 3; transcript: Zorkin's invitation and Putin's oath

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: After the oath Zorkin declares: "Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin has taken office as President of Russia"; the item is headed "Vladimir Putin took office as President of Russia" and says Zorkin announced his assumption of office as head of the Russian state. Putin then speaks "on taking office as President of the Russian Federation".
rows.locator: Heading; lead paragraph 3; transcript: Zorkin's declaration and opening of Putin's address
